comments.author: heraclkingdom
comments.body_html: Hello! I’d like to see my idea implemented in the mod. Each map would have a minimum equipment cost requirement. For example, to enter a map like Tarkov City, your gear (excluding consumables in your backpack) would need to be worth around 200k roubles. The total value would be calculated using the ODT Item Info mod, which sums up the cost of all your equipped items. For the sake of realism, bots should also be subject to the same rule — their gear must meet the minimum threshold for the map as well.
